scripts.//test:routing: The partner redirect table. `lib/partnerRouting.ts` has no imports and no React on purpose, so the real module compiles and runs standalone — the spec exercises the shipped code, not a copy of it.
scripts.test:routing: rm -rf .routing-test && tsc lib/partnerRouting.ts lib/partnerRouting.spec.ts --outDir .routing-test --module commonjs --target ES2020 --strict --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node .routing-test/partnerRouting.spec.js; code=$?; rm -rf .routing-test; exit $code
scripts.//test:session: The session gate — the only thing that may send somebody to /login. `lib/sessionGate.ts` has no imports and no React on purpose, so the real module compiles and runs standalone and the spec exercises shipped code.
scripts.test:session: rm -rf .session-test && tsc lib/sessionGate.ts lib/sessionGate.spec.ts --outDir .session-test --module commonjs --target ES2020 --strict --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node .session-test/sessionGate.spec.js; code=$?; rm -rf .session-test; exit $code
